ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white surface (estimated 85%) with localized low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (estimated 15%) primarily in discrete spots and trailing edge borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface displays a contiguous white field; several high-contrast, roughly circular black blobs are mapped to the mid-inferior quadrant of the left lobe; dark mottling and high-intensity black borders are mapped to the distal tips and the entire length of the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; vertex angle approximately 55 degrees with high edge definition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude saw-tooth pattern; continuous sequence of distinct triangular peaks and corresponding U-shaped valleys extracted along the entire posterior boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp concave upward sweep at the distal lobe terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of textured, high-contrast white and brown pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips and the crests of the trailing edge serrations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible sessile cirripedia (barnacle) encrustations at the outer distal points and along the trailing edge peaks; distinct circular pigmentation marks/scars on the left lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and rhythmic rhythmic saw-like profile of the trailing edge topography.
